pli-tv-kd16:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd16:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ apaññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.1.4: araññe rukkhamūle pabbate kandarāyaṃ giriguhāyaṃ susāne vanapatthe ajjhokāse palālapuñje,
pli-tv-kd16:1.1.6: araññā rukkhamūlā pabbatā kandarā giriguhā susānā vanapatthā ajjhokāsā palālapuñjā pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena sammiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhū iriyāpathasampannā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahako seṭṭhi kālass' eva uyyānaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.2: addasā kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi te bhikkhū kālass' eva tato-tato upanikkhamante
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.5: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.6: sac' āhaṃ bhante vihāre kārāpeyya vaseyyātha me vihāresū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.7: na kho gahapati bhagavatā vihārā anuññātā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.8: tena hi bhante bhagavantaṃ paṭipucchitvā mama āroceyyāthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.10: kho te bhikkhū Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.11: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.13: kathaṃ nu kho bhante paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.14: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd16:1.2.16: vihāraṃ aḍḍhayogaṃ pāsādaṃ hammiyaṃ guhan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yena Rājagahako seṭṭhi ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.4: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi ekāhen' eva saṭṭhiṃ vihāre patiṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.5: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi te saṭṭhiṃ vihāre pariyosāpetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.7: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.3.9: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.1: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.4: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.6: ete me bhante saṭṭhi vihārā puññatthikena saggatthikena kārāpitā,
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.8: tena hi tvaṃ gahapati te saṭṭhiṃ vihāre āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa saṃghassa patiṭṭhāpehīti.
pli-tv-kd16:1.4.9: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi bhagavato paṭissutvā te saṭṭhiṃ vihāre āgatānāgatassa cātuddisassa saṃghassa patiṭṭhāpesi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd16:1.5.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
pli-tv-kd16:1.5.24: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||5||1||
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.2: bhagavatā kira vihārā anuññātā 'ti, sakkaccaṃ vihāre kārāpenti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.7: bhitticchiddaṃ karitvā valliyāpi rajjuyāpi kavāṭaṃ bandhanti,
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave aggaḷavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.18: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū na sakkonti kavātaṃ apāpurituṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:2.1.23: pi te ugghāṭetvā pavisanti vihārā aguttā honti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.2.1: tena kho pana samayena vihārā tiṇacchādanā honti
pli-tv-kd16:2.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ogumphetvā ullittāvalittaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.2.5: tena kho pana samayena vihārā avātapānakā honti acakkhussā duggandhā.
pli-tv-kd16:2.2.12: cakkalikantarikāya pi kālakāpi vagguliyo pi pavisanti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chamāya sayanti,
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.2: gattāni pi cīvarāni pi paṃsukitāni honti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.5: tiṇasanthārako undurehi pi upacikāhi pi khajjati.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.11.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa sosāniko masārako mañco uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.17: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa sosāniko bundikābaddho mañco uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.23: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa sosāniko kulīrapādako mañco uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.3.29: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa sosāniko āhaccapādako mañco uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.4.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa āsandiko uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.4.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave uccakam pi āsandikan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.4.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave uccakam pi sattaṅgan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ucce mañce sayanti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.5.2: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:2.5.7: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu nīce mañce sayanto ahinā daṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.5.10: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ucce mañcapaṭipādake dhārenti saha mañcapaṭipādakehi pavedhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.6.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa suttaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.6.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṅge vijjhitvā aṭṭhapadakaṃ vetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.6.15: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aḍḍhakāyikāni bimbohanāni dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.6.16: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:2.6.21: anujānāmi bhikkhave sīsappamāṇaṃ bimbohanaṃ kātun ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe giraggasamajjo hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.4: te vītivatte samajje chaviṃ opāṭetvā haranti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.5: addasāsaṃ kho bhikkhū samajjaṭṭhāne bahuṃ uṇṇaṃ pi colam pi vākam pi tiṇaṃ pi paṇṇaṃ pi chaḍḍitāni,
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.8: uṇṇabhisiṃ colabhisiṃ vākabhisiṃ tiṇabhisiṃ paṇṇabhisin ti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.9: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa senāsanaparikkhāradussaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.12: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū mañcabhisiṃ pīṭhe saṃharanti pīṭhabhisiṃ mañce saṃharanti,
pli-tv-kd16:2.7.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave ullokaṃ karitvā santharitvā bhisiṃ onandhitun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena titthiyānaṃ seyyāyo setavaṇṇā honti kāḷavaṇṇakatā bhūmi gerukaparikammakatā bhitti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave vihāre setavaṇṇaṃ kaḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikamman ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.5: tena kho pana samayena pharusāya bhittiyā setavaṇṇo na nipatati.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave thusapiṇḍaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā setavaṇṇaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.8: setavaṇṇo anibandhanīyo hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṇhamattikaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā setavaṇṇaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.12: tena kho pana samayena pharusāya bhittiyā gerukā na nipatati.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave thusapiṇḍaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā gerukaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave kuṇḍakamattikaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā gerukaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.17: gerukā anibandhanīyā hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.19: accussannaṃ hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.21: tena kho pana samayena pharusāya bhūmiyā kāḷavaṇṇo na nipatati.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.23: anujānāmi bhikkhave thusapiṇḍaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā kāḷavaṇṇaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.24: kāḷavaṇṇo anibandhanīyo hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocessuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.25: anujānāmi bhikkhave gaṇḍamattikaṃ datvā pāṇikāya paṭibāhitvā kāḷavaṇṇaṃ nipātetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.1.26: kāḷavaṇṇo anibandhanīyo hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vihāre paṭibhānacittaṃ kārāpenti
pli-tv-kd16:3.2.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:3.2.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd16:3.3.1: tena kho pana samayena vihārā nīcavatthukā honti, udakena ottharīyanti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.3.12: tena kho pana samayena vihārā ālakamandā honti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.3.16: tirokaraṇiṃ ukkhipitvā olokenti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:3.3.21: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū khuddake vihāre majjhe gabbhaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd16:3.3.24: anujānāmi bhikkhave khuddake vihāre ekamantaṃ gabbhaṃ kātuṃ mahallake majjhe 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd16:3.4.1: tena kho pana samayena vihārassa kuḍḍapādo jīrati.
pli-tv-kd16:3.4.6: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno tiṇacchādanā ahi khandhe papati,
pli-tv-kd16:3.4.8: bhikkhū upadhāvitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:3.4.10: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd16:3.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū mañcapāde pi pīṭhapāde pi thavikāyo laggenti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.5.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū mañce pi pīṭhe pi cīvaraṃ nikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd16:3.5.9: tena kho pana samayena vihārā anālindakā honti apaṭissaraṇā.
pli-tv-kd16:3.5.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave ālindaṃ paghanaṃ pakuṭaṃ osarakan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse bhattavissaggaṃ karontā sītena pi uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.6.16: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.6.17: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse chamāya cīvaraṃ pattharanti,
pli-tv-kd16:3.6.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave ajjhokāse cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjun ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd16:3.8.1: tena kho pana samayena vihārā aparikkhittā honti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.8.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggalavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñchanacchiddaṃ āviñchanarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.8.14: tena kho pana samayena pariveṇaṃ cikkhallaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.9.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pariveṇe tahaṃ-tahaṃ aggiṭṭhānaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd16:3.9.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ aggisālaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.9.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ . . . āviñchanarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.10.7: tath' eva ajakāpi pasukāpi uparope viheṭhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.10.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave koṭṭhakā apesiyam akkavāṭaṃ toraṇaṃ palighan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.11.1: tena kho pana samayena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro saṃghassa atthāya sudhāmattikālepanaṃ pāsādaṃ kārāpetukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.11.3: kin nu kho bhagavatā chadanaṃ anuññātaṃ kiṃ ananuññātan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:3.11.6: iṭṭhakāchadanaṃ silāchadanaṃ sudhāchadanaṃ tiṇachadanaṃ paṇṇachadanan ti. ||11||3||
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa bhaginipatiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.2: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Rājagahaṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahakena seṭṭhinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṃgho nimantito hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.4: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi dāse ca kammakare ca āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.5: tena hi bhaṇe kālass' eva uṭṭhāya yāguyo pacatha bhattāni pacatha sūpāni sampādetha uttaribhaṅgāni sampādethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.6: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.7: pubbe khv' āyaṃ gahapati mayi āgate sabbakiccāni nikkhipitvā mamañ ñeva saddhiṃ paṭisammodati,
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.8: so dān 'ayaṃ vikkhittarūpo dāse ca kammakare ca āṇāpeti:
pli-tv-kd16:4.1.10: kiṃ nu kho imassa gahapatissa āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati mahayañño vā paccupaṭṭhito rājā vā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.1: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi dāse ca kammakare ca āṇāpetvā yena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā saddhiṃ paṭisammoditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.3: pubbe kho tvaṃ gahapati mayi āgate sabbakiccāni nikkhipitvā mamañ ñeva saddhiṃ paṭisammodasi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.4: so dāni tvaṃ vikkhittarūpo dāse ca kammakare ca āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.6: kiṃ nu kho te gahapati āvāho vā bhavissati vivāho vā bhavissati mahāyañño vā paccupaṭṭhito rājā vā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.7: na me gahapati āvāho bhavissati nāpi vivāho bhavissati nāpi rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ balakāyena,
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.16: ghoso pi kho eso gahapati dullabho lokasmiṃ yad idaṃ
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.18: sakkā nu kho gahapati imaṃ kālaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.19: akālo kho gahapati imaṃ kālaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.20: sve dāni tvaṃ kālena taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissasi arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.22: sve dān' āhaṃ kālena taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissāmi arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti
pli-tv-kd16:4.2.23: buddhagatāya satiyā nippajjitvā rattiyā sudaṃ tikkhattuṃ uṭṭhāsi pabhātaṃ maññamāno. ||2||
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.1: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Sītavanadvāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.3: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nagaramhā nikkhantassa āloko antaradhāyi andhakāro pāturahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso udapādi
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.5: atha kho Sīvako yakkho antarahito saddaṃ anussāvesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.13: abhikkantan te seyyo no paṭikkantan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.14: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa andhakāro antaradhāyi āloko pāturahosi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.15: yaṃ ahosi bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso so paṭippassambhi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.3.28: tatiyam pi kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa andhakāro . . . so paṭippassambhi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.1: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Sītavanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ajjhokāse caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.3: addasā kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.4: disvāna caṅkamā orohitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.5: nisajja kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.4.9: haṭṭho udaggo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.1: atha kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.6: evam eva Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.8: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.10: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.13: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.14: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.15: adhivāsetu ca me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.5.17: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.2: Anāthapiṇḍikena kira gahapatinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṃgho nimantito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.3: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.4: tayā kira gahapati svātanāya buddhapamukho saṃgho nimantito
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.6: demi te gahapati veyyāyikaṃ yena tvaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa bhattaṃ kareyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.7: alaṃ gahapati atthi me veyyāyikaṃ yenāhaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa bhattaṃ karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.9: Anāthapiṇḍikena kira gahapatinā svātanāya buddhapamukho saṃgho nimantito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.10: atha kho Rājagahako negamo Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.11: tayā kira gahapati svātanāya buddhapamukho saṃgho nimantito
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.13: demi te gahapati veyyāyikaṃ yena tvaṃ buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa bhattaṃ kareyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.6.16: assosi kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro . . .,
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.1: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.4: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.6: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.7.9: atha kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.1: tena kho pana samayena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bahumitto hoti bahusahāyo ādeyyavāco.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.2: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Rājagahe taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena Sāvatthi tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.3: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati antarā magge manusse āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.4: ārāme ayyo karotha vihāre patiṭṭhāpetha dānāni paṭṭhapetha,
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.6: so ca mayā bhagavā nimantito iminā maggena āgacchissatīti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.7: atha kho te manussā Anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā uyyojitā ārāme akaṃsu vihāre patiṭṭhāpesuṃ dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.8: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Sāvatthiṃ gantvā samantā Sāvatthiṃ anuvilokesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.8.10: yaṃ assa gāmato n' eva avidūre na accāsanne gamanāgamanasampannaṃ atthikānaṃ-atthikānaṃ manussānaṃ abhikkamanīyaṃ divā appākiṇṇaṃ rattiṃ appasaddaṃ appanigghosaṃ vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppan ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.1: addasā kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Jetassa kumārassa uyyānaṃ
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.2: gāmato n' eva avidūre na accāsanne . . . paṭisallānasāruppaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.3: disvāna yena Jeto kumāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Jetaṃ kumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.4: dehi me ayyaputta uyyānaṃ ārāmaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.8: gahito na gahito 'ti vohārike mahāmatte pucchiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.10: yato tayā ayyaputta aggho kato gahito ārāmo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.9.11: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati sakaṭehi hiraññaṃ nibbāhāpetvā Jetavanaṃ koṭisantharaṃ santharāpesi. ||9||
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.1: sakiṃ nīhaṭam hiraññaṃ thokassa okāsassa koṭṭhakaṃ sāmantā na ppahoti.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.2: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati manusse āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.5: atha kho Jetassa kumārassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.6: na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati yathāyaṃ gahapati tāva bahuṃ hiraññaṃ pariccajatīti,
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.13: ayaṃ kho Jeto kumāro abhiññāto ñātamanusso.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.14: mahiddhiyo kho pana evarūpānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasādo 'ti
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.16: atha kho Jeto kumāro tasmiṃ okāse koṭṭhakaṃ māpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:4.10.17: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Jetavane vihāre kārāpesi, pariveṇāni kārāpesi, koṭṭhake kārāpesi, upaṭṭhānasālāyo k., aggisālāyo k., kappiyakuṭiyo k., vaccakuṭiyo k., caṅkame k., caṅkamanasālāyo k., udapāne k., udapānasālāyo k., jantāghare k., jantāgharasālāyo k., pokkharaṇiyo k., maṇḍape kārāpesi. ||10||4||
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.4: tena kho pana samayena manussā sakkaccaṃ navakammaṃ karonti
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.5: ye pi bhikkhū navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhenti te pi sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.6: atha kho aññatarassa daliddassa tunnavāyassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.7: na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati yathā yime manussā sakkaccaṃ navakammaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.8: yan nūnāham pi navakammaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.9: atha kho so daliddo tunnavāyo sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ madditvā iṭṭhakāyo cinitvā kuḍḍe uṭṭhāpesi.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.10: tena akusalakena citā vaṅkā bhitti paripati.
pli-tv-kd16:5.1.12: tatiyam pi kho so daliddo tunnavāyo sāmaṃ cikkhallaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.1: atha kho so daliddo tunnavāyo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.2: ye ime samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ denti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ te ime ovadanti anusāsanti tesañ ca navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.4: na maṃ koci ovadati vā anusāsati vā navakammaṃ vā adhiṭṭhetīti.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa daliddassa tunnavāyassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd16:5.2.10: kinti nu kho vihāro khippaṃ pariyosānaṃ gaccheyyā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.2: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammaṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd16:5.3.8: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa gahapatino vihāraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno navakammassa dānaṃ so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antevāsikā bhikkhū buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa purato-purato gantvā vihāre parigaṇhanti seyyāyo parigaṇhanti:
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.3: idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.4: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito gantvā vihāresu pariggahitesu seyyāsu pariggahitāsu seyyaṃ alabhamāno aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.5: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ukkāsi,
pli-tv-kd16:6.1.10: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.6: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā buddhapamukhassa . . . pariggahessanti . . .
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.11: ko bhikkhave arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.13: yo bhagavā khattiyakulā pabbajito so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.2.41: chaḷabhiñño so arahati aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.4: tittiro ca makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.5: te aññamaññaṃ agāravā appatissā asabhāgavuttikā viharanti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.6: atha kho bhikkhave tesaṃ sahāyānam etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.7: aho nūna mayaṃ jāneyyāma amhākaṃ jātiyā mahantataraṃ, taṃ mayaṃ sakkareyyāma garukareyyāma māneyyāma pūjeyyāma tassa ca mayaṃ ovāde tiṭṭheyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.8: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro ca makkaṭo ca hatthināgaṃ pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.10: yadāhaṃ sammā chāpo homi imaṃ nigrodhaṃ antarā satthīnaṃ karitvā atikkamāmi, aggaṅkurakaṃ me udaraṃ chupati.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.12: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro ca hatthināgo ca makkaṭaṃ pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.14: yadāhaṃ sammā chāpo homi chamāyaṃ nisīditvā imassa nigrodhassa aggaṅkurakaṃ khādāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.16: atha kho bhikkhave makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca tittiraṃ pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.19: tato ahaṃ ekaṃ phalaṃ bhakkhitvā imasmiṃ okāse vaccaṃ akāsiṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.21: tadā p' ahaṃ sammā jātiyā ma hantataro 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.22: atha kho bhikkhave makkaṭo ca hatthināgo ca tittiraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.24: taṃ mayaṃ sakkarissāma garukarissāma mānessāma pūjessāma tuyhañ ca mayaṃ ovāde tiṭṭhissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.25: atha kho bhikkhave tittiro makkaṭañ ca hatthināgañ ca pañcasu sīlesu samādapesi attanā ca pañcasu sīlesu samādāya vattati.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.26: te aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:6.3.27: etaṃ kho bhikkhave Tittiriyaṃ nāma brahmacariyaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.1: tena hi nāma bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharissanti,
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.2: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā vihareyyātha.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave yathāvuḍḍhaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ aggāsanaṃ aggodakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:6.4.7: na ca bhikkhave saṃghikaṃ yathāvuḍḍhaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:6.5.2: pure upasampannena pacchā upasampanno avandiyo, anupasampanno avandiyo, nānāsaṃvāsako vuḍḍhataro adhammavādī av., mātugāmo av., paṇḍako av., parivāsiko av., mūlāya paṭikassanāraho av., mānattāraho av., mānattacāriko av., abbhānāraho avandiyo.
pli-tv-kd16:6.5.5: pacchā upasampannena pure upasampanno vandiyo, nānāsaṃvāsako vuḍḍhataro dhammavādī vandiyo, sadevake bhikkhave loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vandiyo.
pli-tv-kd16:7.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā saṃghaṃ uddissa maṇḍape paṭiyādenti santhare paṭiyādenti okāse paṭiyādenti.
pli-tv-kd16:7.3: saṃghikañ ñeva bhagavatā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ anuññātaṃ no uddissakatan ti buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa purato-purato gantvā maṇḍape parigaṇhanti santhare parigaṇhanti okāse parigaṇhanti:
pli-tv-kd16:7.4: idaṃ amhākaṃ upajjhāyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ bhavissati, idaṃ amhākaṃ bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd16:7.5: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto buddhapamukhassa saṃghassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito gantvā maṇḍapesu pariggahitesu santharesu pariggahitesu okāsesu pariggahitesu okāsaṃ alabhamāno aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:7.6: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya ukkāsi,
pli-tv-kd16:7.11: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd16:7.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd16:7.19: na bhikkhave uddissakatam pi yathāvuḍḍhaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:8.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhattagge antaraghare uccāsayanamahāsayanāni paññāpenti seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:8.2: āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ goṇakaṃ cittakaṃ paṭikaṃ paṭalikaṃ tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddhalomiṃ ekantalomiṃ kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:8.7: gihivikataṃ abhinisīdituṃ na tv eva abhinipajjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:8.8: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhattagge antaraghare tūlonaddhaṃ mañcam pi pīṭham pi paññāpenti.
pli-tv-kd16:8.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave gihivikataṃ abhinisīdituṃ na tv eva abhinipajjitun ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.3: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.5: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.7: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.8: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.10: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.11: atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.12: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.14: tena hi tvaṃ gahapati Jetavanaṃ āgatānāgatacātuddisassa saṃghassa patiṭṭhāpehīti.
pli-tv-kd16:9.1.15: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavato paṭissutvā Jetavanaṃ āgatānāgatacātuddisassa saṃghassa patiṭṭhāpesi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:9.2.1: atha kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
pli-tv-kd16:9.2.24: atha kho bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||2||9||
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa ajīvakasāvakassa mahāmattassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.2: āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane anantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpesi,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.4: atha kho so mahāmatto ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane bhikkhū vuṭṭhāpessanti,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.7: nanu nāma labbhā aññatrāpi nisinnena yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa mahāmattassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane anantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpessati,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.13: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane anantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpesi, bhattaggaṃ kolāhalaṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.16: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pacchā āgantvā vippakatabhojane anantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpessasi,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.23: sace vuṭṭhāpeti pavārito ca hoti, gaccha udakaṃ āharā 'ti vattabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.24: evaṃ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.25: no ce labhetha sādhukaṃ sitthāni gilitvā vuḍḍhatarassa āsanaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:10.1.26: na tv evāhaṃ bhikkhave kenaci pariyāyena vuḍḍhatarassa bhikkhuno āsanaṃ paṭibāhitabban ti vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.3: na mayaṃ āvuso sakkoma vuṭṭhātuṃ, gilān' amhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.4: mayaṃ āyasmante vuṭṭhāpessāmā 'ti pariggahetvā vuṭṭhāpetvā ṭhitake muñcanti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.9: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa paṭirūpaṃ seyyaṃ dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:10.2.13: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū lesakappena senāsanaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū aññataraṃ paccantimaṃ mahāvihāraṃ paṭisaṃkharonti
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.3: addasāsuṃ kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiye bhikkhū vihāraṃ paṭisaṃkharonte,
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.5: ime āvuso sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū vihāraṃ paṭisaṃkharonti,
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.9: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiye bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.17: tumhe pi vasatha mayam pi vasissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.18: uṭṭhethāvuso, amhākaṃ vihāro pāpuṇātīti kupitā anattamanā gīvāyaṃ gahetvā nikkaḍḍhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.22: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhe saṃghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.23: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.24: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhū saṃghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhissantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.25: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.26: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhū saṃghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.1.30: na bhikkhave kupitena anattamanena bhikkhu saṃghikā vihārā nikkaḍḍhitabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.2: kena nu kho senāsanaṃ gāhetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ senāsanagāhāpakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.5: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatim gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, gahitāgahitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.7: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd16:11.2.9: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ senāsanagāhāpakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.1: atha kho senāsanagāhāpakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.2: kathan nu kho senāsanaṃ gāhetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ bhikkhū gaṇetuṃ, bhikkhū gaṇetvā seyyā gaṇetuṃ, seyyā gaṇetvā seyyaggena gāhetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.11: gahite anubhāge añño bhikkhu āgacchati. na akāmā dātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.12: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nissīme ṭhitassa senāsanaṃ gāhenti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.14: na bhikkhave nissīme ṭhitassa senāsanaṃ gāhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū senāsanaṃ gahetvā sabbakālaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.18: na bhikkhave senāsanaṃ gahetvā sabbakālaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:11.3.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassānaṃ temāsaṃ paṭibāhituṃ, utukālaṃ na paṭibāhitun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd16:11.4.8: aparajjugatāya pavāraṇāya āyatiṃ vassāvāsatthāya antarāmuttako gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto Sāvatthiyaṃ senāsanaṃ gahetvā aññataraṃ gāmakāvāsaṃ agamāsi,
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.3: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.4: ayaṃ kho āvuso āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṃghe adhikaraṇakārako.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.5: sac' āyaṃ idha vassaṃ vasissati sabbeva mayaṃ na phāsu vasissāma.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.8: nanu tayā āvuso Upananda Sāvatthiyaṃ senāsanaṃ gahitan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.10: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso Upananda eko dve paṭibāhasīti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto eko dve paṭibāhissatīti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.15: bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidane etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.16: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda eko dve paṭibāhasīti.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.19: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa eko dve paṭibāhissasi.
pli-tv-kd16:12.1.20: tattha tayā moghapurisa gahitaṃ idha mukkaṃ, idha gahitaṃ kho tatra mukkaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa-ādissa āyasmato Upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.3: bhagavā anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti . . . Upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati,
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso āyasmato Upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.5: te 'dha bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato Upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.6: āyasmā Upāli ṭhitako uddisati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāravena,
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.8: tattha therā c' eva bhikkhū kilamanti āyasmā ca Upāli.
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ uccatare vā dhammagāravena,
pli-tv-kd16:13.1.11: therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ nīcatare vā dhammagāravenā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bahū bhikkhū āyasmato Upālissa santike ṭhitakā uddesaṃ patimānentā kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave samānāsanikehi saha nisīditun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave tivassantarena saha nisīditun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.8: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā samānāsanikā mañce nisīditvā mañcaṃ bhindiṃsu, pīṭhe nisīditvā pīṭhaṃ bhindiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave tivaggassa mañcaṃ tivaggassa pīṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.11: tivaggo pi mañce nisīditvā mañcaṃ bhindi, pīṭhe nisīditvā pīṭhaṃ bhindi.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave duvaggassa mañcaṃ duvaggassa pīṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū asamānāsanikehi saha dīghāsane nisīdituṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā paṇḍakaṃ mātugāmaṃ ubhatovyañjanakaṃ asamānāsanikehi saha dīghāsane nisīditun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:13.2.19: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ tiṇṇaṃ pahoti ettakapacchimaṃ dīghāsanan ti. ||2||13||
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Visākhā Migāramātā saṃghassa atthāya sālindaṃ pāsādaṃ kārāpetukāmā hoti hatthinakhakaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.3: kin nu kho bhagavatā pāsādaparibhogo anuññāto kiṃ ananuññāto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.6: tena kho pana samayena rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa ayyakā kālaṃkatā hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.7: tassā kālaṃkiriyāya saṃghassa bahuṃ akappiyabhaṇḍaṃ uppannaṃ hoti seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.8: āsandi pallaṅko goṇako cittakā paṭikā paṭalikā tūlikā vikatikā uddhalomī ekantalomī kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇi kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:14.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave āsandiyā pāde bhinditvā paribhuñjituṃ, pallaṅkassa vāle bhinditvā paribhuñjituṃ, tūlikaṃ vijaṭetvā bimbohanaṃ kātuṃ, avasesaṃ bhummattharaṇaṃ kātun ti. ||14||
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ gāmakāvāse āvāsikā bhikkhū upaddutā honti āgantukagamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpentā.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.3: etarahi kho mayaṃ āvuso upaddutā āgantukagamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpentā.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso sabbaṃ saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ ekassa dema
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.6: te sabbam pi saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ ekassa adaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.7: āgantukā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.11: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ vissajjethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ vissajjessantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.16: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ vissajjentīti.
pli-tv-kd16:15.1.19: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ vissajjessanti.
pli-tv-kd16:15.2.1: pañc' imāni bhikkhave avissajjiyāni na vissajjetabbāni saṃghena vā gaṇena vā puggalena vā,
pli-tv-kd16:15.2.6: idaṃ paṭhamaṃ avissajjiyaṃ na vissajjetabbaṃ saṃghena vā gaṇena vā puggalena vā,
pli-tv-kd16:15.2.17: lohakumbhī lohabhāṇakaṃ lohavārako lohakaṭāhaṃ vāsī pharasu kuṭhārī kuddālo nikhādanaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:15.2.21: vallī veḷu muñjababbajaṃ tiṇaṃ mattikā dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kiṭāgiri tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi Sāriputtamoggallānehi ca.
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.3: bhagavā kira Kiṭāgiriṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi Sāriputtamoggallānehi ca.
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso sabbaṃ saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ bhājema,
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.5: pāpicchā Sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā,
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.6: na mayaṃ tesaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpessāmā 'ti, te sabbaṃ saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ bhājesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.7: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Kiṭāgiri tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.8: atha kho bhagavā sambahule bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.11: bhagavā āvuso āgacchati mahatā . . . Sāriputtamoggallānehi ca,
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.12: bhagavato ca āvuso senāsanaṃ paññāpetha bhikkhusaṃghassa ca Sāriputtamoggallānānañ cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.13: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā yena Assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Assajipunabbasuke bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.19: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā icchissati tasmiṃ vihāre vasissati,
pli-tv-kd16:16.1.20: pāpicchā Sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā,
pli-tv-kd16:16.2.1: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ bhājitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd16:16.2.4: kathaṃ hi nāma Assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ bhājessantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:16.2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:16.2.9: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā saṃghikaṃ senāsanaṃ bhājessanti.
pli-tv-kd16:16.2.13: pañc' imāni bhikkhave avebhaṅgiyāni na vibhajitabbāni saṃghena vā gaṇena vā puggalena vā,
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Kiṭāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Āḷavī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.2: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Āḷavī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Āḷavakā bhikkhū evarūpāni navakammāni denti:
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.61: d., yāvajīvikam pi n. d., dhūmakālikam pi pariyositaṃ vihāraṃ navakammaṃ denti. ye te bhikkhū appicchā . . . vipācenti: kathaṃ hi nāma Āḷavakā bhikkhū evarūpāni navakammāni dassanti . . . dhūmakālikam pi pariyositaṃ vihāraṃ navakammaṃ dassantīti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. saccaṃ kira bhikkhave. saccaṃ bhagavā. vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi: na bhikkhave piṇḍanikkhepanamattena navakammaṃ dātabbaṃ, . . .,
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.62: na dhūmakālikaṃ pariyositaṃ vihāraṃ navakammaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:17.1.64: anujānāmi bhikkhave akataṃ vā vihāraṃ vippakataṃ vā navakammaṃ dātuṃ; khuddake vihāre kammaṃ oloketvā chapañcavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātuṃ, aḍḍhayoge kammaṃ oloketvā sattaṭṭhavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātuṃ, mahallake vihāre pāsāde vā kammaṃ oloketvā dasadvādasavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sabbaṃ vihāraṃ navakammaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.3: na bhikkhave sabbo vihāro navakammaṃ dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ekassa dve denti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.9: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ gahetvā aññaṃ vāsenti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.11: na bhikkhave navakammaṃ gahetvā añño vāsetabbo.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ gahetvā saṃghikaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.15: na bhikkhave navakammaṃ gahetvā saṃghikaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekaṃ varaseyyaṃ gahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.18: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nissīme ṭhitassa navakammaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.20: na bhikkhave nissīme ṭhitassa navakammaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.22: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ gahetvā sabbakālaṃ paṭibāhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.24: na bhikkhave navakammaṃ gahetvā sabbakālaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:17.2.26: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassānaṃ temāsaṃ paṭibāhituṃ, utukālaṃ na paṭibāhitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ gahetvā pakkamanti pi vibbhamanti pi kālam pi karonti
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.23: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā pakkamati.
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.25: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.28: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā vippakate pakkamati, . . .,
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.33: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā pariyosite pakkamati,
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.35: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā pariyosite vibbhamati, . . .,
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.38: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu navakammaṃ gahetvā pariyosite ummattako paṭijānāti, . . ., pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhittako paṭijānāti,
pli-tv-kd16:17.3.40: idha . . . pariyosite paṇḍako paṭijānāti, . . ., ubhatovyañjanako paṭijānāti, saṃgho
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aññatarassa upāsakassa vihāraparibhogaṃ senāsanaṃ aññatra paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.2: atha kho so upāsako ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā aññatraparibhogaṃ aññatra paribhuñjissantīti.
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.7: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū uposathaggam pi sannisajjam pi harituṃ kukkuccāyantā chamāya nisīdanti,
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.8: gattāni pi cīvarāni pi paṃsukitāni honti.
pli-tv-kd16:18.1.11: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa mahāvihāro udriyati.
pli-tv-kd16:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa senāsanaparikkhāriko mahaggho kambalo uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:19.1.4: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa senāsanaparikkhārikaṃ mahagghaṃ dussaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:19.1.7: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa acchacammaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū adhotehi pādehi senāsanaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd16:20.1.4: na bhikkhave adhotehi pādehi senāsanaṃ akkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:20.1.6: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū allehi pādehi senāsanaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd16:20.1.9: na bhikkhave allehi pādehi senāsanaṃ akkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:20.1.11: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saupāhanā senāsanaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū parikammakatāya bhūmiyā nuṭṭhuhanti,
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.7: tena kho pana samayena mañcapādāpi pīṭhapādāpi parikammakataṃ bhūmiṃ vilikhanti.
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū parikammakataṃ bhittiṃ apassenti,
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.16: apassenaphalakaṃ heṭṭhato bhūmiṃ vilikhati uparito bhittiṃ
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave heṭṭhato ca uparito ca colakena paliveṭhetun ti.
pli-tv-kd16:20.2.19: tena kho pana samayena dhotapādakā nipajjituṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.2: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.6: icchanti uddesabhattaṃ nimantanaṃ salākabhattaṃ pakkhikaṃ uposathikaṃ pāṭipadikaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave saṃghabhattaṃ uddesabhattaṃ nimantanaṃ salākabhattaṃ pakkhikaṃ uposathikaṃ pāṭipadikan ti.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.9.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū attano madhurabhattāni gahetvā lāmakāni bhattāni bhikkhūnaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhattuddesakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.12: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, uddiṭṭhānuddiṭṭhañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.24: atha kho bhattuddesakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd16:21.1.27: anujānāmi bhikkhave salākāya vā paṭṭikāya vā upanibandhitvā opuñjitvā uddisitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd16:21.2.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa senāsanapaññāpako na hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ senāsanapaññāpakaṃ sammannituṃ: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . paññattāpaññattañ ca jāneyya. evañ ca pana bhikkhave sammannitabbo . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa
pli-tv-kd16:21.2.2: bhaṇḍāgāriko na hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhaṇḍāgārikaṃ sammannituṃ: yo na
pli-tv-kd16:21.2.3: chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . guttāguttañ ca jāneyya. evañ ca . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa cīvarapaṭiggāhako na hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarapaṭiggāhakaṃ sammannituṃ: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . gahitāgahitañ ca jāneyya. evañ ca . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa
pli-tv-kd16:21.2.6: phalabhājako na hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvabhājakaṃ ( . . . yāgubhājakaṃ . . . phalabhājakaṃ) sammannituṃ: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . bhājitābhājitañ ca jāneyya. evañ ca . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa
pli-tv-kd16:21.2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ khajjakabhājakaṃ sammannituṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa bhaṇḍāgāre appamattako parikkhāro uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ appamattakavissajjakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.4: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . vissajjitāvissajjitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.16: tena appamattakavissajjakena bhikkhunā ekekā sūci dātabbā satthakaṃ dātabbaṃ upāhanā dātabbā kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ aṃsavaddhako dātabbo parissāvanaṃ dātabbaṃ dhammakarako dātabbo kusi dātabbā aḍḍhakusi dātabbā maṇḍalaṃ dātabbaṃ aḍḍhamaṇḍalaṃ dātabbaṃ anuvāto dātabbo paribhaṇḍaṃ dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.17: sace hoti saṃghassa sappi vā telaṃ vā madhu vā phāṇitaṃ vā, sakiṃ paṭisāyituṃ dātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.18: sace puna pi attho hoti, puna pi dātabbaṃ, sace puna pi attho hoti, puna pi dātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.19.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa sāṭiyagāhāpako . . . pattagāhāpako na hoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah'
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.20: aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ sāṭiyagāhāpakaṃ ( . . . pattagāhāpakaṃ) sammannituṃ: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . gahitāgahitañ ca jāneyya. evañ ca . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.25: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ ārāmikapesakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.26: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya . . . pesitāpesitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.27: evañ ca . . . dhārayāmīti. tena kho pana samayena
pli-tv-kd16:21.3.37: na hoti, sāmaṇerā apesiyamānā kammaṃ na karonti . . . dhārayāmīti. ||3||21||
